hint_ladder: Say that a choice keeps time free for something else.
Use save with the noun time; time is uncountable here, so no article goes before it.
Start with the words: Taking the train ___ us a lot of time.
teaching_content.reveal_form: Taking the train saves us a lot of time.
canonical_forms: Taking the train saves us a lot of time.
alternative_realizations: We saved time by booking online.
